operators.name: sqrt_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: same as reference step input, e.g., [batch, channels, height, width]

semantics: Element-wise square root of input tensor, preserving shape, dtype, device, and strides (contiguous output).
Corresponds to reference statement x = torch.sqrt(x).

operators.name: round_forward

parameters.name: input
parameters.shape: same as reference step input, e.g., [batch, channels, height, width]

semantics: Element-wise rounding to nearest integer, ties to even, preserving shape, dtype, device, and strides (contiguous output).
Corresponds to reference statement x = torch.round(x).

operators.name: conv_transpose2d_forward
semantics: Performs 2D transposed convolution (ConvTranspose2d) using cuDNN.
Input: [N, C_in, H, W], weight: [C_in, C_out, kH, kW], bias: [C_out] (optional, default None).
Output height = (H-1)*stride - 2*padding + kernel_size + output_padding; similarly for width.
Bias is added per output channel if provided; else no bias addition.
Corresponds to reference module self.conv_transpose with parameters in_channels=3, out_channels=16, kernel_size=(3,3), stride=(2,2), padding=(1,1), output_padding=(1,1).
All tensor inputs must be on CUDA; output is a contiguous CUDA tensor.
Element-wise square root of input tensor.
Input shape [512, 3, 40, 40], dtype float32, on CUDA.
Output shape same as input.
Result stored in variable x for next step.
Element-wise rounding of x from previous step to nearest integer, ties to even.
Output shape [512, 3, 40, 40], dtype float32, on CUDA.
Result stored in variable x for next step.
Applies ConvTranspose2d with weight shape [3,16,3,3], bias shape [16], stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1.
Input shape [512,3,40,40] -> output shape [512,16,80,80].
Output dtype float32, on CUDA, contiguous.
Result stored in variable x.
Returns the final output tensor from step_003.
Shape [512,16,80,80], dtype float32, on CUDA.
